trial_court: High Court of Meghalaya at Shillong, WP(C) No. 52 of 2012
case_name: Shri Sudama Yadav vs Union Of India And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: Union of India, Director General of Assam Rifles, General Officer Commanding, Brigadier (Pers), Inspector General Assam Rifles, Commandant

facts_of_case: Petitioner was enrolled in Assam Rifles and his wife left him in 1995. He was ordered to pay maintenance to her. Petitioner challenges the order deducting 27.5% from his pay for maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: Opportunity of hearing is a fundamental right and must be afforded to the affected party.
legal_principles.held: I have heard the learned counsel for both the parties and perused the material on record.

legal_principles.principle: A competent authority must pass a fresh order after affording opportunity of hearing to the affected party.
legal_principles.held: Shri Sudama Yadav vs Union Of India And Ors on 23 March, 2017
cited_cases: Shri Sudama Yadav vs Union Of India And Ors (2017)

outcome.final_order: Order dated 30th November, 2002 set aside and petitioner's pay not to be deducted for maintenance.
